name: application-command
title: Command
description: Command palette (⌘K style) with grouped, keyboard-navigable results and a typed groups/items prop contract.
useWhen: Building a global search or quick-action launcher triggered by a keyboard shortcut.
Users need to jump between pages, run actions, or search content without leaving the keyboard.
You want grouped, filterable results with visible keyboard shortcuts next to each item.
avoidWhen: The list of actions is small enough for a simple dropdown menu or toolbar.
Touch-only interfaces where keyboard shortcuts add no value.
You need multi-select or drag-to-reorder — use a list or table component instead.
responsiveBehavior: The palette is a fixed-width panel intended to sit centered in a full-screen overlay; on narrow viewports, reduce the max-width and hide the ESC hint if space is tight.
accessibility: The input carries aria-label and the results list uses role='listbox' with role='option' items.
The selected/active item sets aria-selected='true' so screen readers announce the current match.
Keyboard hints (arrows, enter) are shown as visible kbd chips, not just implied by icons.

variants.title: Command
variants.description: Command palette with a search input, grouped results, per-item shortcut chips, and a keyboard-hint footer.
accessibility: Result groups use a visually distinct heading; the active option is marked with aria-selected, not color alone.

variants.title: Command (Dark)
variants.description: Command palette adapted for dark surfaces with the same grouped-results and shortcut-chip structure.
accessibility: Text, kbd chips, and the selected-row background must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
